mentions.h: REEBOK SURREY LEAGUE DIV. 1 RACE 1, BROCKWELL PARK, 10 OCT
Tomlinson Trophy comes our way in "Southern Champs."
mentions.note: won South of England Cross Country Championships 2000, 47:58

photos.c: Paul Freary, tracked here by the eventual winner Dave Taylor of Blackheath, was first man home for the Bels. at Parliament Hill in this the toughest of the cross country championships.
